method: Official pages inspected with Aside; CesiumJS Moon-fixed API checked with Context7. Subsequently used an explicitly authorized, scoped local token for read-only ion endpoint and four tileset JSON documents. Credentialed URLs, tokens and endpoint response were not retained.

sources.finding: Official setup selects Moon ellipsoid, disabled globe and asset 2684829. Source table lists LOLA polar gridded data and a LOLA/Kaguya midlatitude merge. Page does not establish an explicit DE421 frame realization, tileset root transform, immutable asset revision or measured landmark residuals.

MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 closely aligns with MOON_ME_DE421 but is not identical. Principal-axis and IAU_MOON frames differ materially. Generic aliases may select a different realization. A runtime Moon-fixed transform does not identify a terrain asset frame.
Engine dataset manifest preserves the product's DE421 mean-Earth frame and 1737400 m reference sphere; rendered LOLA-derived data does not imply the same realization or mesh.
Context7 reports the addition of lunar fixed/ICRF transformations in CesiumJS 1.120. This is API provenance, not asset registration evidence.

catalog_warning: USGS Gazetteer coordinates are nomenclature feature centers with multiple control-network choices, not matched terrain fiducials. Active page tables displayed Planetographic, +East, -180 to 180. No DE421 realization or elevation is inferred.

authorized_asset_inspection.access_scope: assets:read for Moon asset only; local Referer; no binary tile requests
authorized_asset_inspection.hash_definition: SHA-256 of response bytes returned by urllib before optional gzip decompression; sizes in bytes. These observations do not pin a vendor immutable asset revision. Asset.version is the 3D Tiles format version.
authorized_asset_inspection.finding: Root declares Moon and 1737400 m spherical radii. Regional child transforms include a non-unit scale and opposite quarter-turn Y rotations. No inspected JSON declares the DE421 realization, a lunar control network, terrain-fiducial coordinates or independent alignment residuals. Tile-space transforms are not an analysis-frame bridge.

transform_convention.meaning: Each regional root matrix maps local tile coordinates into its parent asset coordinates. Ancestor and descendant transforms must compose in hierarchy order; none is the MOON_ME_DE421-to-renderer transform.
transform_convention.translation_units: 3D Tiles Cartesian meters; all observed translation components are zero
transform_convention.datum: Unknown lunar orientation realization, source horizontal control network and vertical datum. Moon radius extension alone does not establish them.
